QuestInfo.name: Betty's Spring Flower Research 3
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that #bDr. Betty in Ellinia#k is researching spring flowers but she needs your help. Let's go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Let's help with the research to plant far more spring flowers!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully helped with the Spring Flower Research and finally, far more spring flowers bloom in Maple World.
QuestInfo.summary: Give 3 Clovers to Betty in Ellinia.

0.0: Did you know that we are researching spring flowers for planting? We want far more of them in the Maple World! Your flowers will be a great help to our research.

yes.0: It will be a great help to the research on spring flowers in Maple World if you can deliver #b3 Clovers#k to #bDr. Betty in Ellinia#k.  Hope you can do this now.

1.0: I want to have much more spring flowers bloom so I need flowers for my research. Do you have some Clovers for me?

yes.0: Clovers mean 'luck'. I wish you have always good luck in Maple World. I will give you a #bClover Sticker#k!

npc.0: Why didn't you go to Betty quickly? You have to go to Ellinia and give her #b3 Clovers#k.

item.0: Please double-check that you have #b3 Clovers#k. I am really busy researching now.
